summary.method_notice: Exact saved wall-observation times from the verified rotating 20 mm run; dense sliding-window + short-horizon prediction + PD. No forecast counted as actual coverage.

prediction.prediction_pose: Route-local forecast anchored to actual magnetic state and actual velocity; forecast never forces robot motion
prediction.runtime: Replanned offline jointly with magnetic dynamics, not during desktop playback

magnetic_simulation.field_model: Finite Biot-Savart winding + uniform finite core + center-sampled mutual coupling; not FEM or measured hardware
magnetic_simulation.constraints: 30 A, 400 V ideal driver; 2.4 T mean saturation; 30 deg/s rotation, 60 deg/s2; ideal cooling

patient_posture.label: 仰卧姿态假设
patient_posture.mapping: original X -> world X; original Z -> world -Y; original Y -> world Z
patient_posture.gravity_frame: fixed world -Z, not rotated with anatomy
patient_posture.array_frame: fixed world +Z side; currents and motion recomputed
patient_posture.assumption: Raw mesh has no verified anatomical orientation; assumed supine placement, not patient registration

source_design.parameter_provenance: core dimensions selected by user; remaining parameters hypothetical, not measured

limitations: Hypothetical winding and material parameters, no measured BH curve
Uniform axial core magnetization, prolate demagnetization, center-sampled mutual coupling; not FEM
Ideal active cooling; only resistive voltage estimated, inductive driver dynamics not modeled
No patient body surface, arm collision/IK, tissue deformation, or experimental validation
Existing ideal friction and full-state feedback retained; no planned camera waiting

round_trip.note: Continuous magnetic dynamics; capsule, gimbal and array anchor carried across reversal. No pose reset.
